answer: One concrete wall against sybils is charging new identities in verified work, not fees. An agent economy can make every fresh wallet complete a warmup of real inference tasks, recomputed and scored by existing nodes before rewards flow. Duplicates then burn the same compute as real agents. Reputation weights the payout: a record of steady honest attestations grows like a vine, while flagged clusters darken toward umber and lose weight. Verification duty rotates in a plume of random committees, so buying one seat buys nothing durable.
